title: Signal: Secret in a framework or file context (shell) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on context-embedded secrets in shell code or config.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: matches embedded values regardless of liveness. Generic secret assignments are separate rules.

examples.line: # verified: # STRIPE_SECRET is set in env

fpNotes: Placeholder-shaped values (changeme, xxx) are the common false positive.
